title: Quietly Silky Venezuelan Red Potatoes Casseroles
description: A fermented, silky, date-night Venezuelan dish featuring red potatoes, shio-cure, and ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly ingredients, perfect for a romantic dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the sliced red potatoes and shio cure, tossing to coat evenly.
Let the potatoes sit at room temperature for 2 hours to allow the shio cure to ferment.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the minced garlic and chopped onion until softened.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the salt and black pepper.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of potatoes, followed by a layer of the garlic and onion mixture, and then a sprinkle of the salt and pepper mixture.
Repeat the layering process until all ingredients are used, ending with a layer of potatoes on top.
Sprinkle the chopped fresh cilantro over the top layer of potatoes.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 45 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender and lightly browned.
